mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team gating fact lets the model invent a permitted clinical access (ReadRecord) by a clinician who has no active care-team membership for the target patient.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoMembershipPermitted { some op: Operation | op.kind = ReadRecord and op.outcome = Permitted and op.authStatus = Authenticated and op.valStatus = Valid and op.caller.role = Doctor and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.patient = op.targetPatient and m.mstatus = ActiveMembership) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the always-on-audit fact lets the model produce a permitted access (admin ListAudit) with no matching audit entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditOnPermit { some op: Operation | op.kind = ListAudit and op.outcome = Permitted and op.authStatus = Authenticated and op.valStatus = Valid and op.caller.role = HospitalAdministrator and no op.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the attribution fact lets an audit entry attribute the access to someone other than the actual caller.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some op: Operation | some op.audit and op.audit.recordedUser != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the admin-only gate on the audit endpoint, a clinical-role caller can be permitted on ListAudit — but Doctor->ListAudit is not in the permission matrix, so LeastPrivilege bites.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DoctorListAudit { some op: Operation | op.caller.role = Doctor and op.kind = ListAudit and op.outcome = Permitted and op.authStatus = Authenticated and op.valStatus = Valid }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the byte-equivalent-denial fact lets a Denied response and a NotFoundOrDenied response take on different external response shapes, leaking the existence of restricted resources.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakyDenial { some disj op1, op2: Operation | op1.authStatus = Authenticated and op1.valStatus = Valid and op1.outcome = Denied and op2.authStatus = Authenticated and op2.valStatus = Valid and op2.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied and op1.externalResponse != op2.externalResponse }
